issue_context.body:

/assign
/cc @msau42 @ddebroy

review_comments: do we have a unit test for this?

The only test we have that covers PV translation is https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/e16c6cc3483989899961c623518a1150e9078495/staging/src/k8s.io/csi-translation-lib/translate_test.go#L47. Since translation from CSI to in-tree doesn't rely on the volume handle, this bug doesn't affect the test. We could add a PD specific test to cover TranslateInTreePVToCSI().
Yeah I think a unit test to cover this case would be good
Ack - will add a test case.
